description: Remove a topic from FUTURE Deep AI Dive runs. Past run results, answers and citations are NOT deleted — history and trends stay intact. Free and instant, no run is started. Drops the topic from the saved selection; a custom topic ('custom-…') is also deleted from the menu, while a derived topic stays listed (selected=false) and can be re-selected later in the dashboard. Refused with { removed: false, message } when a run is in progress, when it is the only topic left in the selection (a run needs at least one), or when topicId is unknown. Get ids from ai_visibility_topics_list.

topicId.description: Topic id from ai_visibility_topics_list (e.g. 'custom-pet-insurance' or a derived id).

name: ai_visibility_topic_remove
